ability.ants.agony.name: Agony
ability.ants.agony.description: The most painful sting in the forest: 40 spell damage and a 1-second stun, then for 6 seconds the target moves 30% slower and takes 25% more damage. Venom Glands makes it last 10 seconds.
ability.ants.alarm.name: Alarm
ability.ants.alarm.description: Sound the alarm: allied units within 9 units deal 35% more damage and attack 15% faster for 6 seconds.
ability.ants.barbed-needles.name: Barbed Needles
ability.ants.barbed-needles.description: Barbed needles stay in the wound: each hit lowers the target's armor by 1 for 5 seconds, up to 3. Learned at the Fungus Garden.
ability.ants.bivouac.name: Bivouac
ability.ants.bivouac.description: Ultimate. The General and up to 24 allies within 7 units lock together into a living fortress for 8/10 seconds: they cannot move, take 60/70% less damage and return 35% of melee damage to attackers.
ability.ants.cocoon.name: Cocoon
ability.ants.cocoon.description: The colony cannot lose its queen: she spins a cocoon of living silk around herself and sheds every hostile spell. For 6/9/12 seconds nothing can harm her, and she still moves, fights and casts.
ability.ants.corrosion.name: Corrosion
ability.ants.corrosion.description: Venom eats armor: each hit lowers the target's armor by 2 for 5 seconds.
ability.ants.crystallise.name: Crystallise
ability.ants.crystallise.description: Encase a unit in hardened substance for 2/3/4 seconds: an enemy is stunned (half as long on heroes); an ally cannot act but takes no damage.
ability.ants.devour.name: Devour
ability.ants.devour.description: Swallow a non-hero enemy whole and heal 300 health. It is digested over 10 seconds (35 damage a second); killing the Reaver Queen frees it.
ability.ants.found.name: Found
ability.ants.found.description: The Alate lands, sheds its wings and becomes a Brood Mound where it stands: a new tunnel mound and 8 supply. The Alate is used up.
ability.ants.frenzy.name: Frenzy
ability.ants.frenzy.description: Raiders work each other into a frenzy: every second a Raider fights beside other small ants, they gain 6% attack damage, up to 24%. It fades a moment after they part.
ability.ants.fungus-circle.name: Fungus Circle
ability.ants.fungus-circle.description: Grow a ring of glowing fungus for 10 seconds: allied units in it heal 15 health every second. The Reaver Queen is too far gone to be healed.
ability.ants.giant-killer.name: Giant Killer
ability.ants.giant-killer.description: Bullet Ants go for the biggest prey: +15 damage against heroes and units of level 3 and up.
ability.ants.guard.name: Guard
ability.ants.guard.description: Small ants within 6 units of a Major take 15% less damage. Living Wall raises it to 25%.
ability.ants.living-light.name: Living Light
ability.ants.living-light.description: The Queen's living light: it heals an ally 200/400/600 health, or sears an enemy for 100/200/300 spell damage. It never touches the Queen herself.
ability.ants.mandible-charge.name: Mandible Charge
ability.ants.mandible-charge.description: Rush an enemy and seize it in the mandibles: 80/130/180 damage and a 1/1.5/2-second stun.
ability.ants.mark-prey.name: Mark Prey
ability.ants.mark-prey.description: Mark an enemy with hunting scent for 12 seconds: it takes 15/25/35% more damage from everything.
ability.ants.molt.name: Molt
ability.ants.molt.description: Shed the old carapace: heal 35% of her health and move 30% faster for 10 seconds, with 3 less armor until the new one hardens.
ability.ants.one-body.name: One Body
ability.ants.one-body.description: The colony is one body: allies within 10 units of the Queen, the Queen too, take 10/15/20% less damage.
ability.ants.overdose.name: Overdose
ability.ants.overdose.description: Ultimate. Allies in a 6-radius swell with substance for 10 seconds: they attack 40/60% faster, deal 25/40% more damage and move 20% faster, but lose 10 health every second while it lasts.
ability.ants.panic.name: Panic
ability.ants.panic.description: A cloud of fear-scent: enemies in a 5-radius cannot attack or cast for 3 seconds (1.5 on heroes) and move 20% slower. Learned through Pheromone Mastery.
ability.ants.plug.name: Plug
ability.ants.plug.description: Toggle. The Major plants its huge head like a door: it cannot move, but gains 5 armor and takes half damage from missiles and 30% less from siege.
ability.ants.rampage.name: Rampage
ability.ants.rampage.description: Charge an enemy: on contact, 90 damage and a 0.75-second stun to every enemy within 4 units.
ability.ants.ravenous.name: Ravenous
ability.ants.ravenous.description: Mutated. The Reaver Queen starves: she loses 10 health every second, and only Devour and Molt heal her.
ability.ants.rebirth.name: Rebirth
ability.ants.rebirth.description: Ultimate. The Queen pours raw substance into her fallen: up to 8 dead allies within 14 units rise again at full health. The substance stays in them: the reborn deal 25% more damage until they fall again.
ability.ants.royal-presence.name: Royal Presence
ability.ants.royal-presence.description: Ants within 10 units of the Reaver Queen attack 15% faster.
ability.ants.rupture.name: Rupture
ability.ants.rupture.description: Burst now, wherever the Burster stands (Unstable deals the damage).
ability.ants.spore-cloud.name: Spore Cloud
ability.ants.spore-cloud.description: Release a cloud of choking spores for 8 seconds: enemies in it attack 40% slower and move 20% slower. Learned through Pheromone Mastery.
ability.ants.trail.name: Trail
ability.ants.trail.description: Lay a pheromone trail for 12 seconds: allied units in it move 35% faster.
ability.ants.transfusion.name: Transfusion
ability.ants.transfusion.description: Draw 80/120/160 health out of an enemy and pour it into the most wounded ally within 12 units of the Alchemist.
ability.ants.unstable.name: Unstable
ability.ants.unstable.description: Mutated. The Burster bursts on its first bite, and whenever it dies: 100 siege damage to enemies and buildings within 4 units, and 40 to its own allies there. Volatile Sacs raises the blast to 150 and spares allies.
ability.ants.volatile-draught.name: Volatile Draught
ability.ants.volatile-draught.descriptio: Throw a flask of substance venom: it bursts on the target for 90/140/190 spell damage to every enemy within 4 units.
ability.ants.war-column.name: War Column
ability.ants.war-column.description: Allies within 10 units of the General move 10/15/20% faster and deal 10/15/20% more damage.
ability.beetles.arc-surge.name: Arc Surge
ability.beetles.arc-surge.description: Discharge the coil lance into an enemy: a violet arc that jumps to 3/5 enemies, dealing 55/75 spell damage and keeping 80% of it on each jump.
ability.beetles.armor-breaker.name: Armor Breaker
ability.beetles.armor-breaker.descriptio: Every drill strike cracks the target open: its armor falls by 3 for 6 seconds.
ability.beetles.barrier-field.name: Barrier Field
ability.beetles.barrier-field.descriptio: Toggle. Raise the projector pane: enemy missiles fired at the Warden or anyone behind it from the front stop at the pane, 4 units ahead, and shells burst against it. The Warden moves 30% slower and the field costs 2/1 mana each second.
ability.beetles.broadside.name: Broadside
ability.beetles.broadside.description: Fire both cannons at once into an area: 140 siege damage to everything hostile in a 5-radius.
ability.beetles.bulwark-pulse.name: Bulwark Pulse
ability.beetles.bulwark-pulse.descriptio: Pulse the projector: up to 8 allies within 8 units gain a field shield absorbing 120/180 damage for 10 seconds. Unlocked by Specialist Training.
ability.beetles.field-repair.name: Field Repair
ability.beetles.field-repair.description: Channel the welding torch for 4 seconds on a machine or building, restoring 45/70 health each second. Unlocked by Specialist Training.
ability.beetles.flak-beam.name: Flak Beam
ability.beetles.flak-beam.description: The substance beam is tuned against flyers: +10 damage against air units.
ability.beetles.furnace-plating.name: Furnace Plating
ability.beetles.furnace-plating.descript: Riveted furnace plates shrug off magic: spell damage taken is reduced by 30%.
ability.beetles.lock-shields.name: Lock Shields
ability.beetles.lock-shields.description: Toggle. Plant the tower shield and lock its clamps: the Shieldbearer cannot move and attacks 25% slower, but gains 4 armor and takes 30% less piercing damage. Interlocking Shields raises this to 7 armor and 45% less piercing damage.
ability.beetles.mend.name: Mend
ability.beetles.mend.description: Inject a wounded ally with pressurised tonic, restoring 110/160 health. Works on beetles and machines alike. Autocast.
ability.beetles.patch-up.name: Patch Up
ability.beetles.patch-up.description: Bolt fresh plates onto an allied machine, restoring 60 health. Autocast; Tinkers repair buildings by hand.
ability.beetles.static-field.name: Static Field
ability.beetles.static-field.description: Charge the ground for 5 seconds: enemies in a 4-radius take 10/15 spell damage each second and move 25/35% slower. Unlocked by Specialist Training.
ability.coilkeeper.arc-lash.name: Arc Lash
ability.coilkeeper.arc-lash.description: Violet lightning leaps between up to 5 enemies, dealing 75/105/135 spell damage and losing 15% on each jump.
ability.coilkeeper.overload.name: Overload
ability.coilkeeper.overload.description: Detonate an enemy's mana: drain up to 60/100/140 of it and deal 45/70/95 plus the drained amount as spell damage to every enemy within 4 units of the target.
ability.coilkeeper.recharge.name: Recharge
ability.coilkeeper.recharge.description: Pour substance into allies in a 6-radius: they regain 40/70/100 mana and gain a shield absorbing 80/130/180 damage for 8 seconds.
ability.coilkeeper.unbottled.name: Unbottled
ability.coilkeeper.unbottled.description: Shatter the lantern. For 6 seconds a violet storm stands around the Coilkeeper: enemies within 14 units are dragged towards her, enemies within 7 are lifted off the ground and stunned, and arcs strike up to 6 enemies for 16/24 spell damage five times a second. Allies inside are shielded for 220/320 damage.
ability.core.holy-light-lite.name: Holy Light
ability.core.holy-light-lite.description: Restore an ally with a flash of warm light, or sear an enemy with it.
ability.forgemaster.bolt-turret.name: Bolt Turret
ability.forgemaster.bolt-turret.descript: Unfold a brass repeater turret at a point for 40 seconds. It shoots ground and air units and can be destroyed. Rank 3 deploys two.
ability.forgemaster.field-forge.name: Field Forge
ability.forgemaster.field-forge.descript: Allies within 10 units gain 2/3/4 armor. Every second, allied machines and buildings within 10 units are repaired for 6/10/14 health.
ability.forgemaster.forgefall.name: Forgefall
ability.forgemaster.forgefall.descriptio: Call down a red-hot anvil. After a 1.5-second warning circle it slams into a 5-radius area: 200/300 spell damage and a 1.5-second stun (half on heroes), then a pool of molten metal that burns enemies standing in it for 20/32 spell damage each half second for 6 seconds.
ability.forgemaster.overclock.name: Overclock
ability.forgemaster.overclock.descriptio: Pull the governor on an allied unit or machine: it attacks and moves 30/45/60% faster for 8 seconds.
ability.hornbreaker.colossus.name: Colossus
ability.hornbreaker.colossus.description: Become a living siege engine for 18/24 seconds: gain 300/500 maximum health and health, 12/20 damage, 3/5 armor, and 35/50% frontal cleave within 1.5 cells. Physical clearance is unchanged; expiry caps health at the normal maximum.
ability.hornbreaker.horn-rush.name: Horn Rush
ability.hornbreaker.horn-rush.descriptio: Charge a visible ground enemy, respecting terrain and other bodies. On contact deal 90/140/190 spell damage and stun for 1/1.5/2 seconds. Blocked, interrupted or escaped charges do not hit.
ability.hornbreaker.overwhelm.name: Overwhelm
ability.hornbreaker.overwhelm.descriptio: Each damaging primary melee hit marks its target for six seconds, stacking three times. Subsequent basic attacks from this hero gain 5/10/15 damage per stack; the target loses 5/7/10% movement per stack. First hit has no bonus. Hits refresh all stacks; allies do not gain the damage bonus.
ability.hornbreaker.steadfast.name: Steadfast Aura
ability.hornbreaker.steadfast.descriptio: Nearby allied units regenerate 2/3/4 additional health per second and gain 1/2/3 armor within four grid cells. Only the strongest copy applies. Ends when the Hornbreaker falls or an ally leaves the aura.
